approvals.weaknessTitle: A passkey is weaker than hauswart-admin
approvals.weakness: This page comes from the server. If the server is hacked, it can show you one task here and have your passkey confirm another one. Your device then does what was confirmed, not what you saw. That is why a passkey only works for the task types a device allows, such as packages, and never for sudo, certificates, passwords or keys. Even so, a hacked server can use a single touch to install or remove any package from the device's repositories. Only touch your passkey for something you just asked for here. If this page asks you to try again for no reason, stop.
approvals.unavailable: Passkeys need this page on a DNS name over HTTPS with a certificate the browser trusts. A bare VPN address does not work, and a phone needs the Hauswart CA installed.
approvals.empty: Nothing is waiting for a passkey.
approvals.approved: Approved. The device checks the approval itself.
approvals.signingHint: These tasks go beyond what a passkey may approve. Sign them on your computer with hauswart-admin approve.
approvals.signingEmpty: Nothing is waiting for a signature.
approvals.passkeysHint: A new passkey does nothing yet. An admin has to pin it on each device with hauswart-admin passkeys pin. Deleting it here does not remove it from a device, that also takes hauswart-admin.
approvals.registered: Passkey added. Now ask an admin to pin it.
approvals.pinHow: It approves nothing until an admin pins it on a device: in the admin app under Passkeys, or with hauswart-admin passkeys pin --passkey {{id}} --device ID.
approvals.nothingPinnedTitle: None of these passkeys can approve anything yet
approvals.nothingPinned: A passkey works on a device only once an admin pinned it there with a signature, so that a hacked server cannot slip in its own. Ask an admin to pin it in the admin app under Passkeys, or with hauswart-admin passkeys pin.
approvals.subtitle: Approve here what waits for you.
approvals.lapseHint: A waiting task lapses unless someone approves it: a block, screen time or a restart after 2 hours, a live terminal after 15 minutes, everything else after a week.
approvals.batchHint: One touch approves exactly these {{count}} tasks. Each device checks that its task is among them; nothing else can be added.
approvals.approvedSome: {{count}} approved, {{failed}} not. Look at those again.
